scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @lapangango/backend" "npm run dev -w @lapangango/frontend"
scripts.test:db:prepare: npm run db:reset:e2e && npm run db:migrate:e2e && npm run db:seed:e2e
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:db:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 npm run test:integration -w @lapangango/backend
scripts.test:security: npm run test:db:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 npm run test:security -w @lapangango/backend
scripts.test:concurrency: npm run test:db:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 npm run test:concurrency -w @lapangango/backend
scripts.test:b2:integration: npm run test:db:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 npm run test:b2:integration -w @lapangango/backend
scripts.test:b2:security: npm run test:db:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 npm run test:b2:security -w @lapangango/backend
scripts.test:b2:concurrency: npm run test:db:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 npm run test:b2:concurrency -w @lapangango/backend
scripts.test:e2e:b2: docker compose up -d --wait minio && npm run test:db:prepare && npm run build -w @lapangango/backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD=LapanganGo-E2E-123 npm run test:e2e:b2 -w @lapangango/frontend
scripts.db:seed:e2e: cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD=LapanganGo-E2E-123 npm run db:seed -w @lapangango/backend
scripts.db:reset:e2e: docker compose up -d --wait mysql-e2e redis && docker compose exec -T mysql-e2e mysql -uroot -proot_test -e "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS lapangango_e2e; CREATE DATABASE lapangango_e2e CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;"
scripts.test:e2e:b1: docker compose up -d --wait minio && npm run db:reset:e2e && npm run db:migrate:e2e && npm run db:seed:e2e && npm run build -w @lapangango/backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=test PORT=3101 DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD=LapanganGo-E2E-123 npm run test:e2e:b1 -w @lapangango/frontend
scripts.test:manual:b1: docker compose up -d --wait minio && npm run db:reset:e2e && npm run db:migrate:e2e && npm run db:seed:e2e && npm run build -w @lapangango/backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=test DATABASE_URL=mysql://lapangango:lapangango_test@127.0.0.1:3308/lapangango_e2e REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6380/1 SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD=LapanganGo-E2E-123 npm run test:manual:b1 -w @lapangango/frontend
scripts.test:ui-audit: cross-env VITE_SERVER_STATE=off npm run build -w @lapangango/frontend && npm run test:ui-audit -w @lapangango/frontend
scripts.qa:b1:local: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:security && npm run audit:production && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:phase-a && npm run test:e2e:b1 && npm run test:ui-audit && npm run test:manual:b1 && npm run test:concurrency && npm run test:contract && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:docs
scripts.qa:b1:staging: npm run test:tidb:required && cross-env PLAYWRIGHT_EXTERNAL_SERVERS=true npm run test:manual:b1 -w @lapangango/frontend
scripts.qa:b1: npm run qa:b1:local && npm run qa:b1:staging
